name: Halloween Parallax
description: Full-screen WebGL image with a mouse-driven depth parallax, animated smoke, flickering lightning and a pointer-following light, with depth and normal maps generated automatically from the image.
contents: Full-height WebGL canvas showing one image
behavior: Pointer or touch movement shifts the image by generated depth and lights it with a smoothed light
Animated noise adds waves, smoke tint, flickering particles and lightning flashes
Depth, normal and noise maps are generated from the image unless URLs are given
Canvas resizes with its container and the image scales to fit narrow screens
editableByProps: Image, optional depth, normal and noise maps
Background Tailwind class, camera and plane settings, pointer smoothing and animation speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the smoke, lightning or particle look
Change how depth is derived from the image

fixed: Listens to window pointer movement while mounted and removes it on unmount
Container is h-screen and touch-none, so touch drags on it do not scroll the page
